pair.title: Pair with Remote Play
pair.description: A PlayStation Network account is available in Home Assistant.

pair_known.title: Pair with Remote Play
pair_known.description:
On the awake PS5, go to Settings → System → Remote Play → Link Device and enter the eight-digit PIN.

**To wake your PS5 from rest mode**, enable **Stay Connected to the Internet** and **Enable Turning On PS5 from Network** under Settings → System → Power Saving → Features Available in Rest Mode.

pair_sony.title: Pair with Remote Play
pair_sony.description:
[Sign in to PlayStation]({login_url}), then paste the full address from the browser or just the value of `code`.

Example link  
`{redirect_uri}?code=demo-code-123&cid=demo`

Example code  
`demo-code-123`

Already have a Remote Play account ID? Enter it with the prefix `id:`.

On the awake PS5, go to Settings → System → Remote Play → Link Device and enter the eight-digit PIN.

**To wake your PS5 from rest mode**, enable **Stay Connected to the Internet** and **Enable Turning On PS5 from Network** under Settings → System → Power Saving → Features Available in Rest Mode.

error.cannot_connect: No verified response from the console.

error.invalid_account: PlayStation rejected the sign-in code. Sign in again using the link above and paste the new full address.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Open Link Device again and use a fresh PIN.
error.invalid_sign_in: Enter the PlayStation redirect URL or its authorization code.
error.pairing_failed_after_sign_in: Pairing failed. Get a new PlayStation sign-in code and a fresh PIN from Link Device.
error.sony_account_lookup_failed: PlayStation accepted the code but did not provide a usable account ID. Use an existing PlayStation Network account or enter a Remote Play account ID.
error.sony_unreachable: Home Assistant could not complete the connection to PlayStation. Check its internet connection and get a new sign-in code before retrying.
error.sony_unexpected_response: PlayStation did not complete sign-in. Try again later or use a Remote Play account ID.
